publisher: European Commission — eAidRegister and national competent authorities
scope: Transparency records of aid already awarded or reported by participating authorities. These are NOT open calls, application forms or proof that a person/business can apply. Use only to identify public aid instruments, beneficiaries and awarding authorities.
